title: Layer Panel (Sidebar) — Tree View, Drag-and-Drop, Layer Management
description: Create the Layer Panel sidebar component with a hierarchical tree view of layers, drag-and-drop reordering, add/remove layer buttons, inline rename, and visibility toggle per layer. Uses MobX observer for reactive updates from ProjectStore. Supports nested children display with indentation.
acceptance_criteria: LayerPanel renders hierarchical tree of layers from ProjectStore
LayerTreeItem shows layer name, type icon, visibility toggle
Drag-and-drop reordering within the tree (HTML5 drag API or pointer events)
Add layer buttons (Group, Image import via IPC, Text)
Selected layer highlighted, synced with UIStore.selectedLayerId
Nested children displayed with proper indentation
